title: The Burnt Offering

questions.question: From where did the Lord call to Moses?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 1:1 (ESV): "The Lord called Moses and spoke to him from the tent of meeting."

questions.question: What kind of animal could be brought as a burnt offering from the herd?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 1:3 (ESV): "If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without blemish."

questions.question: What did the offerer do with his hand on the burnt offering?
options: Laid his hand on its head for atonement
questions.correctAnswer: Laid his hand on its head for atonement
questions.explanation: Leviticus 1:4 (ESV): "He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him."

questions.question: Where was the burnt offering to be killed?
options: At the entrance of the tent, on the north side of the altar
questions.correctAnswer: At the entrance of the tent, on the north side of the altar
questions.explanation: Leviticus 1:3,11 (ESV): "He shall bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting... he shall kill it on the north side of the altar."

questions.question: What happened to the entire burnt offering on the altar?
options: It was all burned on the altar
questions.correctAnswer: It was all burned on the altar
questions.explanation: Leviticus 1:9 (ESV): "The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, as a burnt offering."

questions.question: What types of birds could be offered as burnt offerings?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 1:14 (ESV): "If his offering to the Lord is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves or pigeons."

questions.question: What did the priests (sons of Aaron) do with the blood?
options: Threw it against the sides of the altar
questions.correctAnswer: Threw it against the sides of the altar
questions.explanation: Leviticus 1:5 (ESV): "Aaron's sons the priests shall bring the blood and throw the blood against the sides of the altar."

questions.question: What was the burnt offering described as?
options: A food offering with a pleasing aroma to the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: A food offering with a pleasing aroma to the Lord
questions.explanation: Leviticus 1:9 (ESV): "A burnt offering, a food offering with a pleasing aroma to the Lord."

questions.question: What animals from the flock could be used for a burnt offering?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 1:10 (ESV): "If his gift for a burnt offering is from the flock, from the sheep or goats."

questions.question: Who put fire on the altar and arranged wood?
options: The sons of Aaron the priest
questions.correctAnswer: The sons of Aaron the priest
questions.explanation: Leviticus 1:7 (ESV): "The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire."

questions.question: What was done with the crop of a bird offering?
options: Removed and cast beside the altar on the east side in the ash heap
questions.correctAnswer: Removed and cast beside the altar on the east side in the ash heap
questions.explanation: Leviticus 1:16 (ESV): "He shall remove its crop with its contents and cast it beside the altar on the east side, in the place for ashes."

questions.question: What parts of the animal were washed with water before burning?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 1:9 (ESV): "Its entrails and its legs he shall wash with water."

questions.question: What was done with the skin of the burnt offering?
options: The priest who offers it shall have the skin
questions.correctAnswer: The priest who offers it shall have the skin
questions.explanation: Leviticus 7:8 (ESV): "The priest who offers any man's burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering."

questions.question: How was the bird offering torn before burning?
options: Torn open by its wings but not divided completely
questions.correctAnswer: Torn open by its wings but not divided completely
questions.explanation: Leviticus 1:17 (ESV): "He shall tear it open by its wings, but shall not sever it completely."

questions.question: After the animal was killed, what did the offerer do?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 1:6 (ESV): "Then he shall flay the burnt offering and cut it into pieces."

key_verse_text: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
